blocks.text: Why most media plan template excel files fail you

You spend hours looking for the perfect media plan template excel. You download five different versions. None of them handle your specific campaign structure. Some have too many tabs. Others use broken formulas. You end up spending more time fixing the template than planning the media buy.

The problem is not the Excel file. The problem is the lack of a system. Digital media planners often fall into the trap of using static files that do not account for the dynamic nature of real-time bidding or changing client budgets. A better approach is to build a modular sheet that grows with your campaign. Lazur can help you build this from scratch on your Mac.
Building your own media plan template in Excel

Start with a clean workbook. Open Excel for Mac. Create your core tabs: Campaign Overview, Budget Allocation, and Performance Tracking. Do not try to make it fancy on day one. Focus on the data flow. If you get stuck on a formula, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to explain how to calculate your CPM or reach.
